notice: Schwab Model Portfolios (Charles Schwab Asset Management), allocations as of September 30, 2026, transcribed from the fact sheets for the internal demo: Core ETF, Core Enhanced ETF and Passive-Active (total return), Income, and Core Enhanced Tax Aware. Some figures were read from photos (Passive-Active especially) and should be checked against the published fact sheets; product yields are illustrative. Product prices and returns are simulated from the synthetic universe via each product's `proxy` rule. Other fund families (Vanguard, Capital Group, Fidelity, Dimensional) were added to the product universe (Model Builder, custom models and holdings imports); their names and tickers are real, their expense ratios are approximate and should be checked, and their yields, prices and returns are simulated like the rest.

lines.name: Core Models
lines.description: Schwab Core ETF portfolios: capital appreciation and income in a total return framework, using Schwab Asset Management's broad asset allocation of market-cap weighted strategies.

lines.name: Core Enhanced Models
lines.description: Schwab Core Enhanced ETF portfolios: total return with market-cap weighted and Fundamental Index strategies (strategic beta, style and sub-asset classes).

lines.name: Active-Passive Models
lines.description: Schwab Passive-Active portfolios: total return combining active management with passive and fundamental approaches.

lines.name: Income Models
lines.description: Schwab Income model portfolios: income with growth, from 10/90 to 60/40, using dividend equity and a broad mix of traditional and non-traditional fixed income.

lines.name: Core Enhanced Tax Aware Models
lines.description: Schwab Core Enhanced Tax Aware portfolios: core enhanced equity with tax-efficient municipal bond allocations within fixed income.
